news.title: Nvidia Introduced Alibaba to Alice Huang for Workaround on U.S. Export Controls
news.summary: Nvidia’s sales team introduced Chinese tech giant Alibaba to Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy involved in smuggling Nvidia chips into China, months before U.S. export controls on advanced semiconductors came into effect in 2022, according to three people with direct knowledge of the matter. Nvidia ’s introductions, which happened on two occasions across several months in 2022, helped Huang and her company land Alibaba as a customer, two of the three people said. From there on, Huang, a newcomer to the chip renting business, was able to get bank loans that helped finance the purchase of Nvidia chips, the two people said.

Following the completion of the transaction, the chief operating officer owned 10,853 shares in the company, valued at approximately $6,950,152.67. This trade represents a 7.96% decrease in their ownership of the stock. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website. The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The sale was made to cover tax withholding obligations related to the vesting of equity awards.

news.title: SemiAnalysis “Downgrading” Accelerator Capex Forecast by 28%, Hours Before Nvidia Reports
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSemiAnalysis cut its forecast for AI accelerator spending in 2028 by 28%, to $758 billion, the day before NVIDIA’s third-quarter report. The cuts fall hardest on NVIDIA: the firm lowered its NVIDIA shipment forecast 22% for 2027 and 39% for 2028, while Broadcom’s custom-chip forecast fell 11% over five years.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 SemiAnalysis 將 2028 年 AI 加速器支出預測下調 28% 至 $758 billion，就在 NVIDIA 第三季財報發布前一天。降幅對 NVIDIA 衝擊最大：該機構將 NVIDIA 出貨預測下調 22% 針對 2027 以及 39% 針對 2028，而 Broadcom 客製化晶片預測則在五年內下降 11%。

news.title: Cathie Wood and 14 Other Big Funds Bought Broadcom. It’s 33% Below Its High. Bargain or Trap?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCathie Wood’s ARK Invest and 14 other big funds bought Broadcom stock in the third quarter, according to their 13F filings. Broadcom trades at 19x forward earnings, well below its five-year average of 24x, while analysts expect its earnings per share to more than quadruple from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2028.

items.title: Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) Stock: Insider Gary Loeb Sells 400 Shares
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (NASDAQ:ISRG - Get Free Report) EVP Gary Loeb sold 400 shares of the company's stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, November 10th. The stock was sold at an average price of $458.15, for a total value of $183,260.00. Following the transaction, the executive vice president directly owned 6,236 shares of the company's stock, valued at approximately $2,857,023.40. The trade was a 6.03% decrease in their ownership of the stock. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this link. The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.

news.title: Meta’s Prepayment Is Buying Oklo’s Nuclear Fuel for Up to Five Reactors
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo (OKLO) signed definitive agreements with Centrus Energy (LEU) on November 12 to secure enough nuclear fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta Platforms (META) is helping finance fuel purchases for Oklo’s planned 1.

news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo (OKLO) 於 November 12 與 Centrus Energy (LEU) 簽署最終協議，確保最多五座 Aurora 發電廠所需的核燃料，交付將於 2029 開始。Meta Platforms (META) 正在協助為 Oklo 計劃的 1 融資採購燃料。

news.title: Oklo Sits Near Its 52-Week Low After a 5-Reactor Fuel Deal. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Oklo 與 Centrus Energy 簽署最終合約，取得足夠 HALEU 燃料最多運轉五座 Aurora 電廠，交貨自 2029 開始。Meta 為未來電力預付款支持採購，Centrus 現計有 $5。

news.title: Oklo Has Lost 76% in a Year. Wall Street Still Sees $56. Bullish Wedbush Sees Just $36
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo has lost 76% in a year, and analysts’ average price target has fallen from $103 to $56. Wedbush repeated its Outperform rating and $36 target on Nov.
news.title_zh: Oklo 一年虧損 76%。華爾街仍看好 $56。看漲的 Wedbush 僅看 $36

news.title: AMD Soars 6%, Broadcom Up 6% as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Exits
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 6% after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO, and Broadcom rose with it. IonQ, SoundHound and Oklo fell instead, as investors cut back on the riskiest AI bets.
news.title_zh: AMD 飆漲 6%，Broadcom 上漲 6%，隨著 Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳離職

news.title: Craig-Hallum Just Cut Its Oklo Target From $53 to $27 After a Better-Than-Expected Quarter
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCraig-Hallum cut its Oklo price target to $27 from $53 on Nov. 9 and kept its Hold rating, three days after Oklo reported a narrower third-quarter loss than expected.

news.title: Oklo Gets Final DOE Operational Clearance For Groves-1 Reactor – Retail Eyes 85% Upside By 2026-End
news.summary: The DOE’s operational restriction clearance will allow the reactor to enter its research, testing, and training phase.
news.title_zh: Oklo 獲得 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐最終運營許可 – 散戶關注 2026 年底前 85% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: DOE 的運營限制許可將允許反應爐進入研究、測試和訓練階段。

news.title: Oklo Rises 4% as DOE Clears Groves-1 Reactor for Unrestricted Operations: “Reset the Nuclear Industry’s Expectations”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo shares jumped 4% today after the Department of Energy cleared its Groves-1 test reactor for unrestricted operations. Groves-1 shows Oklo can build fast, but it still needs a cost for its first Aurora powerhouse and a binding customer.
news.title_zh: Oklo 上漲 4%，因 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐進行無限制運營：「重設核能產業期望」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價今日跳升 4%，因能源部核准其 Groves-1 試驗反應爐進行無限制運營。Groves-1 顯示 Oklo 能快速建設，但仍需首座 Aurora 電廠的成本和具約束力的客戶。

news.title: Oklo Receives DOE Clearance for Groves-1 Reactor Research, Testing and Training Operations
news.summary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) announced that the US Department of Energy (DOE) has cleared the final operations hold point for its Groves Isotope Test Reactor (Groves-1) in Lockhart, Texas, allowing the facility to proceed with research, testing and personnel training activities.
news.title_zh: Oklo 獲得 DOE 批准 Groves-1 反應爐研究、測試和培訓運營
news.summary_zh: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) 宣佈美國能源部 (DOE) 已批准其 Groves 同位素測試反應爐 (Groves-1) 位於德克薩斯州洛克哈特) 的最終運營控制點,允許該設施繼續進行研究、測試和人員培訓活動。

news.title: Oklo Soars 14% in a Week on a Narrower Loss and a Deal for 27 Reactors’ Worth of Forgings
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo stock rose 14% in the week to Nov. 9 on a narrower third-quarter loss and a forging deal for 27 reactors.
news.title_zh: Oklo 因虧損收窄和 27 反應堆鍛件交易，一週內飆升 14%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價在截至 Nov. 9 的一週內上漲 14%，得益於第三季虧損收窄和 27 反應堆的鍛件交易。

news.title: OKLO Stock Is On Track To Reverse 6 Weeks Of Losses, But This Analyst Warns Nuclear Euphoria Is Fading
news.summary: OKLO stock is headed higher on strong third-quarter earnings and a manufacturing agreement with U.S. Forged Rings to support the long-term deployment of its Aurora powerhouses.
news.title_zh: OKLO 股票有望扭轉 6 週的虧損，但分析師警告核能狂熱正在消退
news.summary_zh: OKLO 股票因強勁的第三季財報及與 U.S. Forged Rings 簽訂製造協議以支援其 Aurora 發電廠長期部署而走高。

news.title: IBM Is Down 21% This Year. What Will It Take to Get IBM Stock Back to $250?
news.summary: IBM's software engine is humming, yet one stubborn segment keeps dragging the stock down while rivals Oracle and Accenture chart very different courses. Which part of the business holds the key to a comeback, and what must happen before January?

news.summary_zh: IBM 的軟體引擎運轉順暢，但有一個頑固的部門持續拖累股價，而競爭對手 Oracle 和 Accenture 則走上截然不同的路徑。哪個業務部門掌握反彈關鍵？一月前必須發生什麼事？

news.title: Oracle’s 40% 6 Month Slide Continues: This Analyst Maintains His Buy Rating, Predicting 230% Returns
news.summary: Oracle keeps beating earnings estimates, yet its shares keep sinking while Microsoft and Amazon climb. One backlog number and one giant customer explain why Wall Street and the market disagree so sharply, and which side might be wrong.

news.summary: Oracle is estimated to have over $300 billion in orders from OpenAI, and Wall Street thinks that could be a bad thing.

news.title: Nvidia’s Interim CEO Pushed Back on a “$250 Billion Credit Backstop” for OpenAI. Oracle Has the Most at Stake
news.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Information reports that Nvidia’s interim CEO, Colette Kress, pushed back on a proposed $250 billion credit backstop for OpenAI while she was finance chief, and that Nvidia is expected to slow its AI investment strategy. Oracle has the most at stake: Steve Eisman puts about half of its $664 billion backlog with OpenAI, and its free cash flow was negative $23.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 臨時執行長反對為 OpenAI 提供「$250 Billion 信用擔保」。Oracle 風險最大
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要The Information 報導，Nvidia 臨時執行長 Colette Kress 在擔任財務長時，反對提議的 $250 billion 信用擔保給 OpenAI，且預期 Nvidia 將放緩其 AI 投資策略。Oracle 風險最大：Steve Eisman 指出其約一半的 $664 billion 積壓訂單來自 OpenAI，且其自由現金流為負 $23。

news.title: CoreWeave Jumped 20% and Pulled Oracle Higher. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOracle sold $20 billion of stock and bonds days after capping new capital-market funding at that amount through fiscal 2030. Bloomberg reported that Microsoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle on older Nvidia chips.
news.title_zh: CoreWeave 飆升 20% 並帶動 Oracle 上漲。是時候賣出，還是加碼？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oracle 在將新資本市場融資上限設定為該金額至財政年度 2030 後幾天，售出了 $20 billion 的股票和債券。彭博社報導，微軟正在逐步終止一項 2023 協議，該協議旨在從 Oracle 租用基於較舊 Nvidia 晶片的 AI 運算。
